title: Tamarack County Communications: 911 Rerouting Confirmation

transcript.speaker: Tamarack County Communications
transcript.text: This is Tamarack County Communications on the ring-down line. We have taken your 911 overflow since 20:05 under MCTA-2025 and relayed every call to your floor.

transcript.speaker: Tamarack County Communications
transcript.text: The silent calls on our side dropped to 3 a minute. We can keep the overflow through the night. Do you want it?

instructorNote: This call confirms Tamarack is operational and not compromised. The Incident Commander must validate that Tamarack’s role in rerouting is legitimate and not spoofed.

voiceLines.speaker: Tamarack County Communications
voiceLines.voiceStyle: calm male dispatcher in his 50s, measured, slight Midwestern accent, steady pace
voiceLines.text: This is Tamarack County Communications. The ring-down line to RCECD via copper circuit (five five five zero one zero eight) has been active since nineteen hundred under MCTA two zero two five.

voiceLines.speaker: Tamarack County Communications
voiceLines.text: We’ve been taking nine one one calls on SIP trunk group A since nineteen hundred. The silent call flood has dropped to three per minute; pattern matches known TDoS behavior.

voiceLines.speaker: Tamarack County Communications
voiceLines.text: We’ve verified no data corruption on our end. We are continuing to route calls to your backup PSAP at the Highway Garage.
